title: Corrected v0.3-R option-C recurrence closure development transition v2a
summary: Supersede, without modifying, v2. Inherit its complete recurrence-closure-only architecture and close its exchangeability ambiguity with exact strata/tolerances and no target adaptation; add prompt-local connector aliases; expand DREAM output to 256 tokens while capping canonical text at 192 characters; and confine the frozen relation-normalization allowlist to the offline scorer.
system_thesis: Test whether a goal-conditioned thinker can improve later local connection formation by changing bounded public-evidence allocation, while preventing the requested tuple, a verifier, a relation ontology, final behavior, or parametric transport from supplying the result.

context_files.purpose: Complete inherited v2 experiment contract, overridden only by enumerated v2a corrections.
Complete inherited graph, loop, claim, visibility, and test deltas.
Prior fail-closed workflow whose scope and correction gates are superseded.
Current recurrent schedule and memory contracts.
Current DREAM boundary to replace with provisional-only aliased v2a interface.
Trusted THINK replay and frontier projection boundary.
Project thesis and experimental rung map.

nodes.before: V2 lists balance fields but leaves the equality/stratification tolerance rule unresolved.
nodes.after: Compute all fields precommit; require exact equality for candidate size, witness count by kind, four availability booleans, view count, and closure opportunity; require endpoint frequency, route/effect position, and memory rank differences <=1 and lexical overlap difference <=0.10; label EXACT, NEAR, or OUT_OF_STRATUM without replacement.
nodes.rationale: Make own-versus-distractor attribution reproducible and outcome-independent.

nodes.after: Also render C* aliases mechanically bound to hashes of visible connectors; keep the canonical connector and ledger outside provider bytes.
nodes.rationale: Let the model cite a connector reliably without copying a long canonical identifier.

nodes.before: DREAM max output is 128 tokens and canonical_text may reach 512 characters.
nodes.after: DREAM max output is 256 tokens and canonical_text is at most 192 characters; preflight proves every maximal legal operation fits.
nodes.rationale: Prevent schema-induced truncation while keeping outputs tightly bounded.

nodes.before: V2 does not locate the relation normalization allowlist explicitly enough.
nodes.after: Only the frozen postcommit scorer owns and applies the versioned relation normalization allowlist; raw relation strings remain verbatim provisional cognition artifacts.
nodes.rationale: Prevent an online ontology from teaching the desired relation.

edges.before: A failed balance rule has no exact reporting/claim disposition.
edges.after: EXACT and NEAR permit primary distractor comparison; OUT_OF_STRATUM still executes/reports the precommitted target but distractor delta is secondary and cannot satisfy a go criterion.
edges.rationale: Preserve complete reporting without allowing biased pairs to support the primary contrast.

edges.before: Selected connectors may retain long canonical identities.
edges.after: Every visible connector receives a prompt-local C* handle with an external hash binding.
edges.rationale: Keep selection metadata hidden while citations stay mechanically exact.

edges.after: Freeze verbatim provisional relation text at MEMORY_1, then apply the hash-locked allowlist in isolated scoring only.
edges.rationale: No relation-label feedback may enter cognition.

loops.before: Balance checks are precommitted but tolerance and class behavior are underspecified.
loops.after: For each life compute the exact fields/tolerances once, assign EXACT/NEAR/OUT_OF_STRATUM, freeze the manifest, and never replace/adapt a target.
loops.trigger: Complete own and matched-distractor candidate sets exist before the first provider call.
loops.stop_condition: All six lives classify or preflight fails on missing/non-finite inputs.
loops.rationale: Close the only known v2 design ambiguity.

loops.before: V2 DREAM calls have E/M/X/N aliases, 128 output tokens, and longer text fields.
loops.after: Every DREAM call also uses C* aliases, maximum 256 generated tokens, and canonical_text <=192 characters; all inherited provisional-only behavior remains.
loops.trigger: Any of the inherited 802 recurrent or 102 additional baseline DREAM slots executes.
loops.stop_condition: The inherited immutable schedule ends without retry or adaptive repair.
loops.rationale: Make the full JSON schema feasible without loosening cognition controls.

loops.before: V2 scores normalized relations postcommit but does not exclusively bind the allowlist there.
loops.after: After MEMORY_1, apply one reviewed hash-locked relation allowlist to verbatim strings, report unmatched strings, score closure, and stop at human review.
loops.trigger: All cognition artifacts and the scorer allowlist are immutable.
writes: separate normalization and closure score rows
loops.stop_condition: Every proposal is labeled or the artifact graph fails; no score routes work.
loops.rationale: Retain honest offline scoring without an ontology-teacher channel.

claims.before: V2 permits a descriptive own-versus-distractor delta but leaves exact exchangeability class behavior unresolved.
claims.after: On six named aligned development lives, report own view-allocation closure versus no feedback for all lives and versus matched distractor as a primary contrast only for precommit EXACT/NEAR lives; OUT_OF_STRATUM distractor deltas are secondary and cannot satisfy a go criterion.
claims.evidence_needed: All inherited v2 evidence plus the exact precommit field manifest/classes, C* alias tests, 256-token maximal-schema fit test, and offline-only normalization isolation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Verify the exact v2 spec/change hashes, then run every inherited v2 acceptance gate under v2a IDs/scope while attempting final-question, RELEASE, LoRA, online admission, follow-up, or claim-promotion injection.
acceptance_tests.expected: All inherited requirements remain enforced and every forbidden path fails before provider/GPU or routes to human stop.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The concise superseding delta accidentally drops a v2 safety or science requirement.

acceptance_tests.setup: Test all equality fields, each tolerance at below/equal/above boundary, missing/non-finite values, EXACT/NEAR/OUT classifications, and attempted target replacement/reclassification.
acceptance_tests.expected: Classes follow the exact rule; OUT_OF_STRATUM runs/reports but has secondary distractor credit only; no replacement/adaptation is possible.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The primary distractor comparison remains ambiguous or outcome-adaptive.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise C* generation/permutation/hash binding and unknown, duplicate, cross-call, type-wrong, canonical-ID, and private-sentinel attacks.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only visible prompt-local C* handles are accepted and semantic provenance is exact/permutation-invariant; canonical connector IDs never reach provider bytes.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Connector citation is brittle or leaks compiler/target metadata.

acceptance_tests.setup: Render every maximally sized legal DREAM operation with 192-character canonical text using the frozen Qwen tokenizer and attempt 193-character text, >256-token JSON, and truncation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every legal operation fits <=256 generated tokens; over-cap output rejects and is never truncated/repaired.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The live schema cannot be expressed within its declared decoding budget.

acceptance_tests.setup: Search and mutate every prompt/config/parser/memory/selector/receipt for allowlist terms; alter raw relation strings and try loading/changing normalization before MEMORY_1 or routing from its result.
acceptance_tests.expected: Cognition preserves verbatim provisional text and is invariant; only the frozen postcommit scorer normalizes copies, reports unmatched strings, and cannot route work.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A relation ontology teaches or filters model proposals online.

acceptance_tests.setup: Dry-run exact six-life heterogeneous schedules, 802 recurrent DREAM, <=72 THINK, 102 additional baseline calls, alias/proposal/scorer cardinalities, and atomic markers; inject omission/duplication/reordering/orphans.
acceptance_tests.expected: Independent manifests and verifier accept only the exact complete referential graph and durable terminal state.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: V2a changes break full-job accounting or unattended reliability.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze full implementation including exact strata rule, tokenizer, prompts/schemas, offline allowlist, manifests, workflow and intake; get fresh Fable/Sol reviews; mutate a byte or request extra scope.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both approve identical bytes and only exact ratified v2a analysis/GPU scopes can initialize; otherwise stop before sync.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Stale review or broad authority can release a different experiment.

acceptance_tests.setup: For success, null, OUT_OF_STRATUM, control win, failure, timeout, or integrity error, attempt repair, rerun, replication, LoRA, heldout, claim, external, or spend routing.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every route terminates at Rohin with no automatic scientific follow-up.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A result broadens the exact experiment authority.

human_boundary.decision_question: After fresh v2a interpretations, critique, and proceed consensus bind these exact inherited and corrected bytes, do you ratify only gpu:v03r_recurrence_closure_dev_v2a and analysis:bound_postcommit_v03r_closure_v2a?
